title: redstono's supa mod
description:
this mod adds - Cleftsteel Gear: Mine common Cleftsteel Ore and craft really op tool + armor sets. Includes the Reinforced Cleftsteel block which is as powerful as obsidian.
- Redsteel Equipment: A red counterpart with an ore, block, ingot, and gear set
body:
Core Additions
- Cleftsteel Set,
Mine the common Cleftsteel Ore and smelt it into ingots which you can eat, useing these ingots you can create op tools, weapons, and armor. much Stronger than netherite and perfect for early quick game progression.
- Reinforced Cleftsteel, its as powerful as obsidian when it coms to explosives but easy to mine


- Redsteel Set
A fiery alternative with its own op ore, block, and gear lineup.
- Bedrock Breaker
A legendary tool with extreme power, rumored to damage the indestructible.
- and the cleft, a dimension with tons of cleftsteel ore
-and the immortality potion which makes you completely immune to death for 30 mins
-and a lot fo op recipes such as for dirt into 64 diamond blocks or one cleft steel ingot into 64 iron, that kind of thing
- I recommend that you use jei for the recipes 


WARNING this is a trash mod, it is really op.



note, the bedrock breaker does not work on the bedrock block, yet

note, this mod does work now.

anybody can use this mod in any modpack
